# `admin_search` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/admin-search.md).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Module id | `admin_search` |
| Name | Global search |
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Ships from | `@endora-commerce/mod-admin-search` |
| Licence | `MIT` |

## Activation

An operator switches this module on and off on **/platform/modules**. The choice is the setting `admin_search.enabled`, and it defaults to **on**.
